title: Car Loan Calculator
description: Compute monthly car payments, total interest and full cost from price, down payment, trade-in, rate and term.
howto: Enter the vehicle price, down payment and trade-in value.
Set the APR and loan term in months.
Read your monthly payment, total interest and total cost instantly.

faqs.q: How is the monthly payment calculated?
faqs.a: With the standard amortizing formula M = P·r(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1) on the financed amount (price minus down payment and trade-in).

faqs.q: Does this include taxes and fees?
faqs.a: No — add your local sales tax, title and dealer fees to the vehicle price first for a true out-the-door number.
It lowers the monthly payment but raises total interest and the risk of owing more than the car is worth.
